newsitem.title: USA: Tribune names publisher for Sun-Sentinel.
newsitem.headline: Tribune names publisher for Sun-Sentinel.

text.p: Tribune Co, the publisher of the Chicago Tribune, said Friday that it named Robert Gremillion publisher of the south Florida-based Sun-Sentinel Co.

Gremillion, currently, vice president and general manager of cable news channel CLTV News and Tribune Regional Programming, also was named to the posts of president and chief executive of Sun-Sentinel, effective May 1.

"Bob Gremillion has been a pioneer in developing the relationship between newspapers and television, which is critical in the digital world," said Jack Fuller, executive vice president of Tribune Publishing Co.

"He has built CLTV into a successful all-news cable channel in affiliation with the Chicago Tribune and helped to put together strong newspaper-television combinations in south Florida and Orlando," Fuller said in a statement.
